svg.title: How a dev bot resource command travels
svg.desc: 1. A command (Set intelligence, Enable auto-join, Disable auto-join or Join game) is run from the devbot resource on the dashboard; BotCommands enables it only while the bot is healthy and checks the game code. 2. BotAdminClient in the AppHost calls the bot admin API on its own endpoint: PUT /admin/intelligence, PUT /admin/auto-join or POST /admin/games/{code}. 3. BotStateMirror polls GET /admin/state every two seconds. 4. When the state changes it publishes the properties devbot.intelligence, devbot.auto-join and devbot.games on the dashboard.
svg.text: A RESOURCE COMMAND, END TO END
from a dashboard button to the bot and back to its properties
1 run a command · 2 call the bot admin API · 3 poll its state · 4 show it as properties
